query:
SELECT id                                   AS "id!",
                   targetid                             AS "targetid!",
                   targettype                           AS "targettype!",
                   groupid                              AS "groupid!",
                   fieldid                              AS "fieldid!",
                   value::text                          AS "value!",
                   createat                             AS "createat!",
                   updateat                             AS "updateat!",
                   deleteat                             AS "deleteat!",
                   COALESCE(createdby, '')              AS "createdby!",
                   COALESCE(updatedby, '')              AS "updatedby!"
              FROM propertyvalues
             WHERE id = $1
               AND ($2 = '' OR groupid = $2)
